business_vintage.label: Business vintage
business_vintage.rationale: Most lenders want 3 years of operations (two filed ITRs and audited years); some NBFCs accept 2. Editable default: LoanBazaar to confirm.

personal_cibil.label: Personal / promoter CIBIL score
personal_cibil.rationale: User core rule: 750 or above is eligible; 700 to 749 is conditionally eligible; below 700 is not eligible; missing is flagged, never assumed.

commercial_cmr.label: Commercial CMR rank
commercial_cmr.rationale: User core rule: CMR rank must be below 7 to satisfy; 7 or above does not satisfy; missing is flagged.

dscr.label: Debt service coverage (DSCR)
dscr.rationale: User core rule: DSCR must be strictly above 1.00 (compared at 2 dp); 1.00 or below does not satisfy; missing inputs are flagged, never fabricated.

banking_credits_vs_requested.label: Requested amount vs average monthly bank credits
banking_credits_vs_requested.rationale: Unsecured business loans are commonly sized at up to 3-4 times average monthly credits. Editable default: LoanBazaar to confirm.

banking_turnover_ratio.label: Banking turnover vs reported revenue
banking_turnover_ratio.rationale: User core rule: banking turnover must be at least 80% of annual revenue; below 80% does not satisfy; missing banking data is flagged.

annual_turnover.label: Annual turnover
annual_turnover.rationale: Typical entry level for unsecured MSME products. Editable default: LoanBazaar to confirm.

gst_turnover.label: GST annual turnover
gst_turnover.rationale: Rs 40 lakh is the GST registration threshold for goods. Editable default: LoanBazaar to confirm.

gst_compliance.label: GST filing compliance
gst_compliance.rationale: Filing regularity is checked by most lenders. Editable default: LoanBazaar to confirm.

tol_tnw.label: TOL / TNW
tol_tnw.rationale: User core rule: TOL/TNW at most 4.00; above 4.00 does not satisfy; missing inputs are flagged.

existing_emi_foir.label: Existing EMI to EBITDA (FOIR)
existing_emi_foir.rationale: EMIs above half of EBITDA leave little room for a new loan. Editable default: LoanBazaar to confirm.

profitability.label: Profitability track record
profitability.rationale: Two profitable years is standard; one year or breakeven goes to credit discretion. Editable default: LoanBazaar to confirm.

current_ratio.label: Current ratio
current_ratio.rationale: 1.33 is the Tandon/Nayak benchmark for working capital. Editable default: LoanBazaar to confirm.

interest_coverage.label: Interest coverage
interest_coverage.rationale: EBIT of at least twice interest is a common comfort level. Editable default: LoanBazaar to confirm.
